data.question: Write a program that reads N and prints N * 3 when N is a multiple of 3, otherwise N * 2.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads N and prints N * 3 when N is a multiple of 3, otherwise N * 2.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It tests N % 3 == 0 and prints either N * 3 or N * 2.
